newsitem.title: USA: US LPGs, and August deals, firm following APIs,.
newsitem.headline: US LPGs, and August deals, firm following APIs,.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were firmer Wednesday following Tuesday's inventory data that showed a fall-off in crude oil stocks.
The American Petroleum Institute data showed a 9.7 million barrel drop in crude oil, which traders said boosted LPG prices.
Propane values in the Mont Belevieu, Texas, market were unchanged at 35.25 and 35.50 cents a gallon, but August propane deals were made at 35.63 and 36.00 cents a gallon.
Propane values in the Conway, Kansas, were also unchanged at 34.25/34.50 cents with deals done at 34.50 cents.
"The upswing is due to higher crude prices on the Merc and, once again, traders covering short positions," one trader said.
In the Belvieu hub August deals for ethane and ethane mix were slightly higher at 21.00 and 20.00 cents respectively.

In the Conway, Kansas, market LPG deals, excepting propane, were about a penny higher than yesterday. Butane was done at 39.50, isobutane at 42.50, natural gasoline at 45.50, and ethane at 18.00 cents. --Tim Gardner, New York Oil Desk +1 212 859 1632 --
